name: s2-worktree-portability-20260718
title: Make validation lock identity and command-spec digest portable across worktrees and hosts
description: validationExecutionLockPath (validation-execution-lock.ts:116) joins projectRoot so two linked worktrees of the same story mint different locks, breaking cross-host serialization; buildDoneRequiredCommandSpecEnvelope (done-required-validation.ts:85) embeds an absolute cwd in the spec digest, so identical logical commands mismatch across roots. Derive the lock root from the shared git common dir / canonical metadata root, and digest a repo-relative logical cwd (recording the physical workspace separately as provenance) with a versioned receipt-envelope migration.
